Prepare step by step

  1. Start with immediate safety, health and mobility needs; call 911 for an emergency.
  2. List daily tasks, transportation, accessibility and support questions without entering private health details here.
  3. Confirm program geography, eligibility, waitlists, costs and service scope directly.
  4. Verify professional credentials, background checks and emergency procedures before choosing paid care.

General preparation and help finding the right resource only—not medical advice, diagnosis, benefits eligibility, care assessment or a caregiving recommendation.

Before you contact or choose a service.

  • Confirm current requirements, hours, eligibility, credentials, service area, accessibility, availability and total cost directly.
  • Keep names, narratives, account details, medical identifiers, child information and document text off this public page.
  • Directory appearance, order and paid status are not rankings, referrals, endorsements or proof of fit.
  • You choose whether to copy, print or share this plan; Franklin Navigator does not send it.
